checks.name: Variable attributes and choices are directly editable inside one center canvas
Editing choice label/value updates one configuration field and workbench selection
Choice add/remove/reorder preserve a selected candidate by explicit occurrence action
V2 exact label/value uniqueness is validated without trimming values or changing case
Default and choice text editing preserve untouched CRLF/CR and leading newlines
editable gates runtime free input while default, saved and configured choices stay available
Config reset covers choices and editable, leaves Windows/history unchanged
V2 export uses app/profile tables and required fields without runtime metadata
Invalid choices remain editable and raw-previewable, while export is blocked
V2 dual-scope variables serialize as one two-record array and Special consistency is enforced
Restoring reordered choices keeps the same candidate and falls back when that choice was edited
Workbench textarea edits preserve untouched raw line endings and leading newline
TOML export escapes DEL while retaining the actual raw configuration value
Config rendering and editing produce no JSDOM runtime errors
